changes: AirDrop over the Wi-Fi firmware's own AWDL (awdl0) on Apple Silicon Macs: the omdrop-awdl helpers with alarm-aurora's three patches (accept NetworkManager's per-network cloned MAC, follow the infra channel, set the 5 GHz social channel) and the omdrop-plugin receiver, all installed off, as alarm-aurora's omdrop-awdl 0.10.5-1.
notes: Needs the pin's extra source omdrop-plugin as a component tarball (orig-omdrop-plugin, unpacked in omdrop-plugin/), which scripts/recipe.py does not provide yet: prepare fails at the receiver patch until it does (see docs/parity/apps.md). The receiver installs omdrop-plugin's public Apple root and AAI CA certificates, as alarm-aurora does.
